pick.headline: Bombing of the federal building in Oklahoma City
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of April 20, 1995, listed Israeli leaders offering aid to Clinton over the Oklahoma City blast and, under Lebanon, Al-Hariri condemning a 'criminal act' and a Shiite leader denouncing the bombing.
